## Context
`src/rebar/_snapshot/janitor.py:1-53, 186-217` mixes current behavior with incident, migration, or implementation narrative. Preserve triggers, hysteresis, LRU, rename-before-delete, and interlocks. No programmatic docstring consumer was found.

## Plan
State the current contract once; remove obvious narration and relocate still-useful history or alternatives to its ticket or ADR.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The cited prose is concise and free of implementation chronology.
- [ ] The preserve list remains explicit and accurate.
- [ ] No behavior-bearing text is lost.

## Verification
Review the diff against the preserve list, run affected tests, and run `rtk .venv/bin/python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`.
